hints.title: Encryption Determinism
hints.text: Each character keys[i] maps directly to values[i]. If any character in word1 is not in keys, encrypt returns empty string.

hints.title: Decryption Inversion
hints.text: Decrypting a string word2 requires finding how many words in dictionary encrypt into word2.

hints.title: Precomputed Encrypted Dictionary
hints.text: Instead of backtracking on ambiguous decryption tokens, encrypt all valid dictionary words during initialization and count their frequencies.

hints.title: Encrypted Dictionary Precomputation

complexity.notes: Preprocessing encrypts all dictionary words once; subsequent decrypt calls take O(1) hash lookup.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Backtracking branching for each 2-letter value in word2 leads to exponential decryption time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dictionary lookup table stores encrypted representations in O(D * L) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate inverts the decryption perspective by preprocessing valid dictionary encryptions.
